question.text: Dakshin Capital Cat II AIF: Committed INR 200 cr. Set-up cost 2.5% of commitments (INR 5 crore, amortised over 5 yr full tenure). Mgmt fee 2% on commitments Y1 (excl. GST @18%). Yearly operating expenses INR 80 lakh. Compute TOTAL Year-1 fee+expense outflow (including GST on mgmt fee).

explanation.text: The Logic: Set-up amortisation Y1 = INR 5 / 5 = INR 1.00 cr. Mgmt fee pre-GST = 2% x 200 cr = INR 4.00 cr. GST @ 18% on mgmt fee = INR 0.72 cr. Operating expense = INR 0.80 cr. Total = 1.00 + 4.00 + 0.72 + 0.80 = INR 6.52 crore. The Trap: A omits GST and opex and set-up; B omits opex; D mis-adds. Cross-Exam Context: Chapter 6 example 6.3 pattern. XIX-C tests. Manager's Pro-Tip: Always show LPs a consolidated 'Year-1 fee & expense waterfall' in the PPM. It's much more impactful than quoting standalone ratios and builds LP trust.
